meta.title: MepMail for Linux: Correio on the desktop (.deb, .rpm, AppImage)
meta.description: Download the MepMail app for Linux: Correio in its own window, with a tray icon, unread count, mepmail:// links and a bridge for AI agents.

linux.title: MepMail on <highlight>Linux</highlight>
linux.lead: Correio in its own window, with a tray icon, unread count, mepmail:// links and the bridge for your AI agents. Pick the package for your distribution.
linux.commandLabel: In a terminal, in the download folder

deb.name: .deb package
deb.body: Installs through the package manager and shows up in the app menu.
deb.updates: the app tells you about a new version and installs it from the tray, with your system password.

rpm.name: .rpm package
rpm.body: Installs through the package manager and shows up in the app menu.
rpm.updates: the app tells you about a new version and installs it from the tray, with your system password.

appimage.name: AppImage
appimage.body: One file, nothing to install. It carries its own WebKitGTK, so it is bigger (about 80 MB).
appimage.updates: the file updates itself, no password needed.

tips: The tray icon uses AppIndicator. On GNOME without the AppIndicator extension (Ubuntu ships it), the app works the same, just without the icon.
Agent keys live in the system keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet), never in a text file.
Start with the system and Keep in tray on close are in the tray icon's menu.
linux.windows: On Windows, the app is in the Microsoft Store.
linux.source: The app's source code on GitHub

hub.title: MepMail on your <highlight>computer</highlight>
hub.lead: MepMail Mail in its own window, outside the browser: it starts with your system, tells you about new mail and connects your AI agents to the mailbox in one click.
hub.note: Version {version} · free app for accounts with MepMail Mail · open source (AGPL-3.0)

windows.name: Windows
windows.body: From the Microsoft Store: signed by Microsoft, installs with no SmartScreen warning, and the Store keeps it up to date.
windows.store: Get it on the Microsoft Store
windows.installerNote: The direct installer updates itself. Use it when the Store is blocked on your PC.

linux.name: Linux
linux.body: The .deb and .rpm packages, or the AppImage that runs without installing. Each comes with its install command and how it updates.

hub.featuresTitle: What the app adds to the browser

features.title: Its own window and tray icon
features.body: Starts with your system, stays in the tray when you close it, and remembers its size and position.

features.title: Unread count
features.body: A dot on the taskbar icon and in the tray shows how many new messages arrived.

features.title: Default email app
features.body: mailto: links open the MepMail Mail composer with the recipient filled in.

features.title: AI agents in one click
features.body: Connects Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code or Codex to your mailbox. The key stays in the system vault, never in a text file.

features.title: Always up to date
features.body: The app loads MepMail Mail from mepmail.dev, so every improvement arrives at once. The app itself updates through the Store or on its own.

features.title: mepmail:// links
features.body: Shortcuts and automations open a mailbox, a folder or a message straight in the app.

hub.otherTitle: On a Mac or a phone?
hub.other: Use MepMail Mail in the browser at mepmail.dev/mail. It works on any system, with the same account.
hub.openWeb: Open MepMail Mail in the browser
